# DearAuditor Open QMS Baseline

> An open-source, GitHub-native electronic Quality Management System (eQMS)
> baseline for medical device and regulated software teams. GitHub Issues,
> Pull Requests, Actions, and Releases form the quality system of record.
> Companies mirror the baseline into a private repository, tailor it,
> validate it, and run their QMS entirely in Git. Covers ISO 9001, ISO 13485,
> ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366-1, IEC 82304-1, ISO/IEC 27001,
> ISO/IEC 42001, EN 18286:2026 (EU AI Act provider QMS), GDPR, Swiss nFADP,
> and an optional GAMP 5 / GxP overlay (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11).

Current published baseline: QMS-2026-10-28-R006
(https://github.com/AliakseiT/dearauditor-qms-baseline/releases/tag/QMS-2026-10-28-R006).
Licensing: Apache-2.0 for code and automation, CC BY-SA 4.0 for documents.
Contact: aliaksei@dearauditor.ch.
